intro.title: Bel Patra Mala
intro.descriptionHtml: Exclusive malas made of fresh and intact Bel leaves and pure silver 108 bel patra mala. Our fresh bel leaves mala are diligently packed to ensure the mala is delivered fresh at your door step, while our silver mala can be used in place of fresh leaves as they are made of pure metals that attract divine vibrations. Shiva Purana recognises Bel patra (leaves) as one of the divine offerings to Lord Shiva especially during Maha Shivratri. Bel leaves mala discharge positive vibes and when offered to Lord Shiva and are believed to easily appease Him and destroy one’s bad karma.
